description: This file contains a Jupyter Notebook that integrates Python code for database interactions, prompts for language models, and orchestrates a flow to generate SQL queries and interpret responses for a school database system. It includes imports, environment setup, database connection, model initialization, prompt formulation, query extraction, data retrieval, and answer generation, specifically aimed at question-answering using a language model with database connectivity.

classes.name: GenerativeModel
classes.description: A class from the Google Generative AI SDK used to generate content from a specified language model.

methods.name: generate_prompt
methods.description: Creates a detailed prompt incorporating the user question and database info to generate an appropriate SQL query.

methods.name: get_query
methods.description: Extracts an SQL query enclosed within ```sql code block from the model's output.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Executes the provided SQL query on the database and fetches results.

methods.name: generate_final_prompt
methods.description: Prepares a comprehensive prompt aggregating question, SQL, data, and table info for answer generation.

methods.name: get_text_content
methods.description: Extracts text from the model's response object.
